First, we reorganize the equations so that they are in the right order, to get

$$
{\begin{aligned}4x-y=5 \\ x+3y=2.\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we can represent this system of equations in the form $Ax=b:$

$$
[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 2\end{aligned}]
$$

To find the solution, we need to calculate the inverse of the coefficient matrix 
$A=[\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ 1 & 3\end{aligned}].$
This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{A}^{-1} & =\frac{1}{4\cdot 3-1\cdot (-1)}[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =\frac{1}{13}[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

We can now represent the solution to this system as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}x & ={A}^{-1}b \\  & =\frac{1}{13}[\begin{aligned}3 & 1 \\ -1 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}5 \\ 2\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
